signalCli.description: Values passed to the workload subchart. The subchart's own schema validates everything not constrained here.

replicaCount.description: signal-cli registers one device against one account and keeps state on one volume, so the wrapper cannot be scaled out.

envVars.description: Upstream environment variables. Kept open so a variable added by a newer image release can be set without waiting for a chart release; the variables the chart knows about are validated.

MODE.description: signal-cli execution model. json-rpc and json-rpc-native make /v1/receive/{number} a WebSocket; the others leave it a GET.
